steps.tooltip:
Welcome to the tutorial.

This is the game board. Your side is at the bottom, and the enemy is at the top. Each round you place cards and resolve combat.

This is a card.

Name is at the top. The center shows the RPS symbol and value. The bottom shows role and HP. Special effects appear as extra text.

Rock ✊ beats Scissors ✌️.
Scissors ✌️ beats Paper ✋.
Paper ✋ beats Rock ✊.

Winning the RPS matchup gives +3 damage. Losing costs -3.
Try it. Drag the card onto the slot to place it.
